{{Top|leg}}
The '''Festival of Awakening''' was a [[festival]] that was celebrated by the [[Pilgrims]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] by the time they settled on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the years of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Among the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], it was known that children took part in the festivities. The actions of [[Nalen Raloch]] who managed to repel [[Flesh Raider]] incursions allowed the Pilgrims to celebrate the Festival of Awakening.
